params.message:
Cloning keeps an evaluation whole and asks who comes along

A cloned evaluation lost its subgoals and maxima and got today's date.
cloneWithProject loaded attainmentLevels (level = 1 only) and synced it by
id, so the pivot max stayed behind and the level-2 rows of the same table
were never read. Every copy also landed on the day of cloning, so all its
evaluations fell in the running term, in cloning order.

- An evaluation copies its att_level_evaluation rows as they are: the
  attainment levels with their max and the subgoals under them. A test by
  question still rebuilds its maxima from its lines (S3-9).
- Its date moves with the project start: as many days after the new start
  as it was after the old one, unless the form says to keep the dates. The
  form shows each evaluation with the date it will get, following the start
  date and that choice as the teacher changes them.
- The pupils a company evaluation names come along when they are in the
  new project. Scores, absences and feedback never do.
- The form asks who comes along: the team (ticked), the class groups and
  the pupils added to the project itself (both unticked, so a copy gets no
  pupils nobody chose). A class group of another school year never comes
  along. For a project of another year the form proposes its dates moved
  by whole school years.
- replicate() handed the original's loaded relations to the copy, so the
  copy could answer with the original's team or pupils; copies now start
  without relations.
- The clone takes its input through CloneProjectRequest: an empty name or
  an end before the start is a validation error instead of a server error,
  and only evaluations of the original are cloned (any evaluation id was
  accepted, also from another school).

Saving the evaluation form wiped its subgoals. syncAttainmentLevels called
sync() on attainmentLevels(), whose level = 1 filter does not reach the
pivot query, so every save detached every subgoal. It now attaches and
detaches only attainment levels, and a level that leaves takes its
subgoals with it.

Rules S1-4.1 to S1-4.5 and a new chapter S2 (R S2-1.1).

Portal: Een project klonen neemt de subdoelen, maxima en de plaats van elke evaluatie mee, en vraagt wie er meegaat. Een evaluatie bewaren laat de subdoelen staan.
